provenance.coordinate_system: Blender Z-up, meters; global positions; local=global minus block origin

data.blender_to_unity_position: GLTF exporter maps (x,y,z) to (x,z,-y). Importer may mirror Z for left-handed Unity; validate reference triad.
data.importer: glTFast or compatible GLB importer required
data.materials: Standard PBR images embedded in GLB. Grating alpha tested in Blender only.
data.colliders: Construct from collision_proxies.json; do not use alpha mesh for grating collision.
data.lights: Rebuild using lighting_groups.json. GLB exports geometry/materials, not Blender area lights.
